name: 控件演示
author: Driftlet
description: 演示全部 20 种设置控件；皮肤界面语言跟随管理器自动切换
description_en: Demo of all 20 settings controls; the skin UI language follows the manager automatically

settings.label: 短文本
settings.description: 显示在皮肤顶部的一行标题
settings.description_en: A one-line title shown at the top of the skin

settings.label: 长文本
settings.description: 多行备注，原样展示
settings.description_en: Multi-line notes, shown verbatim

settings.label: 密码输入
settings.description: 掩码输入，适合 API Key；值不会注入页面，皮肤经 skin_get_setting 读取
settings.description_en: Masked input for API keys; the value is never baked into the page — the skin reads it via skin_get_setting

settings.label: 时间选择
settings.description: 24 小时制，精确到秒
settings.description_en: 24-hour format, precise to the second

settings.label: 日期选择
settings.description_en: Year-month-day, e.g. 2026-01-01

settings.label: 日期时间
settings.description: 日期 + 时间单点，适合倒计时目标
settings.description_en: A single date+time point, e.g. a countdown target

settings.label: 星期选择
settings.description: 选择一周中的一天或多天
settings.description_en: Pick one or more days of the week

settings.label: 时间范围
settings.description: 起止时间精确到秒；起晚于止会自动调换
settings.description_en: Start and end precise to the second; swapped automatically if reversed

settings.label: 单选开关
settings.description: 控制应用区状态点的亮灭
settings.description_en: Controls the status dot in the applied area

settings.label: 多选开关
settings.description: 可同时勾选多项，值是数组
settings.description_en: Multiple choices allowed; the value is an array

settings.label: 互斥开关组
settings.description: 冷纸/暖白/雾蓝——切换应用区的背景色调（全部浅色）
settings.description_en: Cool Paper / Warm White / Mist Blue — tints the applied area background (all light)

settings.label: 下拉选择
settings.description: 舒适/紧凑——切换面板的信息密度
settings.description_en: Comfy / Compact — switches the panel density

settings.label: 调色板
settings.description: 主题色，应用到标题栏与进度条
settings.description_en: Theme color, applied to the title bar and progress bar

settings.label: 滑动条
settings.description: 0 到 100，驱动应用区的进度条
settings.description_en: 0 to 100, drives the progress bar in the applied area

settings.label: 数字输入
settings.description: 带 min/max/step 的数字框
settings.description_en: Numeric input with min/max/step

settings.label: 数字步进
settings.description: −/＋ 按 step 增减；驱动标题栏秒表的跳动间隔（秒）
settings.description_en: −/+ buttons step the value; drives the app bar ticker's interval (seconds)

settings.label: 字体选择
settings.description: 从系统已安装的字体中选择，应用到皮肤文字
settings.description_en: Pick from installed system fonts, applied to the skin text

settings.label: 任务列表
settings.description: 回车或失焦保存，空白项自动忽略
settings.description_en: Saved on Enter or blur; blank items are ignored

settings.label: 待办任务列表
settings.description: 带勾选框的任务行；皮肤也可经 skin_set_setting 写回
settings.description_en: Task rows with checkboxes; the skin can also write back via skin_set_setting

settings.label: 日期任务列表
settings.description: 每条任务带一个日期时间
settings.description_en: Each task carries a date and time
